title_en: 7 Must-Have Sneakers to Step Into the School Year and Fall in Style
summary_en: Foot Locker has the season’s most popular kicks and apparel in stock, with savings of up to 40% for back-to-school.
body_en:
Editor's Note: This article is sponsored by Foot Locker.
Soon we’ll be stepping into a new season, and if you’d like to do that in the latest styles, grab some fresh kicks and apparel from Foot Locker. Not only is there up to 40% off back-to-school essentials like shoes, bags, and more, but Foot Locker also has the hottest trending sneakers in stock in a bunch of sizes, including the New Balance 9060 and the Jordan Retro 3 . All the classics from Adidas, Nike, New Balance, ASICS, and more are available, too. So, whether you’re heading to campus or hitting the gym, you can do so in style with Foot Locker’s back-to-school lineup :
If you’re after a go-to option for everyday, Nike’s Air Force 1 '07 and Adidas’ Originals Campus 00s or Samba are no-brainers. These deliver essential streetwear style and have remained timeless closet staples for a reason, blending comfort, functionality, and fashion. While black and white remain the most popular colorways and are sure to match just about any outfit, these iconic kicks also come in flashier options for those after a bolder look.
Want to make even more of a statement? Get Nike’s Jordan Retro 3 , featuring a unique, eye-catching design with an elephant-print texture. Two color options are currently available: white and blue, or grab the olive option for 30% off if your size is still in stock. The New Balance 9060 is another cool kick that delivers futuristic vibes, combining features of other classic New Balance sneakers like the 990s and 860s.
For shoes that are more functional than fashion-forward, there’s the Nike Zoom Vomero 5 or the ASICS GEL-1130 . Both make excellent running and gym options with a nice modern aesthetic for everyday wear.
No matter which of these sneakers you grab, they’ll seamlessly take you from summer to fall, ensuring you’re classroom- or street-ready.
Foot Locker’s Back-to-School Sale is full swing, saving you up to 40% off select apparel. Beyond athletic wear, socks, and bags, a whole slew of shoes are on sale. Certain colorways of some of the kicks mentioned above are even discounted.
Beyond those deals, Foot Locker has its FLX membership. It’s free to join, with members enjoying free shipping, free returns, and a point system that turns current purchases into FLX Cash to spend on future items. Sneakerheads will also love the members-only sales and opportunity to jump the queue during launch reservations.
Danielle is a Tech freelance writer based in Los Angeles who spends her free time creating videos and geeking out over music history.
